title: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has commented on the expansion of the ban on the energy of Ukraine's energy
text:
There is no point in expanding the ban on energy infrastructure attacks if only one party observes it. This was published in an interview with Izvestia by the Russian Foreign Affairs Ambassador for special tasks for the crimes of the Kyiv Rodion Miroshnik regime.
Russia has shown its ability as a contract, can fulfill certain obligations. Unfortunately, you can talk about Ukraine, the diplomat explained.
He noted that the United States monitored the ban on the ban, and now all the subsequent decisions related to the agreement will be made by Moscow and Washington.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has commented on the expansion of the ban on the energy of Ukraine's energy
Miroshnik noted that the United States received all information about Ukraine's violations of the ban. At the end of their actions, they will have to conclude. Officials admitted that Washington could eventually refuse to continue helping Kyiv.
Earlier, the press secretary of Russian President Dmitry Peskov said that the Kyiv government was not realistic not to comply with the ban on energy facilities.
